text:
Jaya (CSM): heads up — Solstice week0 kickoff ran into two blockers: their service-account role isn't allowing audit log forwarding and the KMS alias we asked them to create conflicts with an existing alias. tagging @Priya @Mason to help unblock. :wave:
Priya (Infra): thanks — can you paste the exact AccessDenied error from their forwarder? and which alias name they used?
Jaya (CSM): Evan sent this earlier: 
Evan (Solstice): "AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::987654321098:assumed-role/solstice-redwood-forwarder is not authorized to perform: s3:PutObject on resource: arn:aws:s3:::solstice-audit-logs/*"
Evan (Solstice): also they created alias name "alias/redwood-prod-kms" but our onboarding docs recommend "alias/redwood-solstice-<env>" — their alias already points to another key in the account.
Mason (Solutions): ok two separate fixes. For the S3 PutObject error their forwarder role needs the bucket policy + PutObject permission. ask them to add the following principal to the bucket policy or attach this inline to the role: 
```
Action: ["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"]
Resource: "arn:aws:s3:::solstice-audit-logs/*"
Principal: {"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/solstice-redwood-forwarder"}
```
Mason (Solutions): for the KMS alias: they can either update the existing alias to the new key (if owner confirms) or create a unique alias e.g. "alias/redwood-solstice-prod-v2". quick CLI to surface aliases: `aws kms list-aliases --profile solstice --region us-east-1`
Priya (Infra): I can validate once they change the policy and/or alias. @Evan can you run `aws sts get-caller-identity` from the forwarder host and paste the role ARN? also send me the bucket policy.
Evan (Solstice): ran the sts command — `arn:aws:sts::987654321098:assumed-role/solstice-redwood-forwarder/i-0abcd1234` — attaching bucket policy (pasted below): 
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowGetBucket",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"Service": "logging.amazonaws.com"},
      "Action": ["s3:GetBucketAcl","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::solstice-audit-logs"
    }
  ]
}
```
Evan (Solstice): looks like we never added the forwarder role as a principal. oops.
Priya (Infra): yep that's the problem. Evan — please add a statement allowing the role the PutObject actions on `arn:aws:s3:::solstice-audit-logs/*`. After that ping me and I'll re-run validation from our side.
Jaya (CSM): flagged as medium renewal risk in the account tracker since their go-live is next Friday and this is blocking log ship. renewing conversation with finance scheduled but want ops green before escalation.
Mason (Solutions): additional gotcha — if they reassign the KMS alias we need export permission for the key metadata so our onboarding script can verify key ARN. Ask them to run `aws kms describe-key --key-id <key-id>` once alias points to right key.
Evan (Solstice): will update bucket policy now and rename alias if needed. can we do a 15m call in 30m to validate together?
Priya (Infra): booked 15m call at 1715502020 (in 30m) on the invite. I'll bring the validation steps.
audit-bot: audit event recorded: onboarding-log-forwarder-policy-change-requested by Jaya (CSM) for org solstice. ticket #CS-8271 created.
Jaya (CSM): thanks all — capture: owner=Evan, action1=add PutObject to bucket for forwarder role, action2=resolve KMS alias conflict or create unique alias, followup call in 30m. I'll update the health playbook and mark "onboard blocking" until validated. :memo:
